WITH currency_stats AS (
  SELECT
    feecoin,
    AVG(rebtotal) as avg_total_rebate,
    AVG(CASE WHEN feerate != 0 THEN (rebrate - feerate) / feerate ELSE NULL END) as avg_relative_gap
  FROM fees
  GROUP BY feecoin
),
benchmark_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_total_rebate) as benchmark
  FROM currency_stats
)
SELECT
  AVG(cs.avg_total_rebate) as avg_of_avg_rebates,
  AVG(cs.avg_relative_gap) as avg_of_avg_gaps,
  AVG(cs.avg_total_rebate - bc.benchmark) as avg_excess
FROM currency_stats cs
CROSS JOIN benchmark_calc bc
WHERE bc.benchmark IS NOT NULL
  AND cs.avg_total_rebate > bc.benchmark

assumptions.assumption: Records with NULL feecoin form a single group (standard SQL GROUP BY behavior treats NULL as a distinct value)
